limitations: Exactly three particles on a simple cycle with nearest-neighbor exclusion; not arbitrary particle number or exclusion radius.
Historical priority of the precise finite-size spectrum against older lattice-gas structure-factor calculations remains subject to specialist verification.
scientific_integrity: Analytical cyclic triple counting, Fourier diagonalization and exact short-length algebra establish the stated results for all n>=7. Finite code checks supplement, not replace, the proof.
title: Sharp Fourier-frame bounds for three hard-core particles on a cycle
